topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture by connecting previous practical work to the session's learning objectives and introducing the historical approach.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses, Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Molecular Genetics of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressors and explore the genetic mechanisms by which their mutations dysregulate the cell cycle.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Multi-Step Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the repair, replication, and mitotic defects that generate sequence and chromosomal instability and explain how this instability accelerates multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate tumorigenesis and evaluate whether ongoing genetic instability remains necessary to sustain malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a review of learning outcomes, recommended reading, and a preview of the upcoming lecture.
